elevenlabsPrompt:
[firm] Still taking a full screenshot and cropping it on your Mac?

[confident] Here's the fix. Press Command, Shift, 5.

[friendly] Pick selection, window, or full screen. Click Options, then Clipboard. Paste it straight into a chat.

[delighted] No more cropping, and no more clutter on your desktop.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
